execute_sql.description: Run SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE queries against the Indeed Auto-Apply database (public schema)

arguments.query: SQL query string. Tables are in the public schema (no prefix needed).

examples: SELECT * FROM adspower_profiles ORDER BY slot ASC;
SELECT * FROM applied_jobs WHERE status = 'success' LIMIT 10;
SELECT * FROM executions ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT * FROM search_combinations WHERE active = true;
UPDATE adspower_profiles SET cookie_status = 'active' WHERE user_id = 'k19td50a';

apply_migration.description: Run DDL (CREATE/ALTER/DROP). Name MUST be globally unique — use timestamps.

arguments.name: Unique migration name (e.g. add_column_20260313). NEVER reuse.
arguments.query: SQL DDL string. Always end with: NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

examples: ALTER TABLE adspower_profiles ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS my_col TEXT DEFAULT ''; NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

list_tables.description: List all tables with columns, types, and row counts.

response_parsing.note: execute_sql wraps results in XML tags. Parse with:
response_parsing.pattern: Unescape (\n → newline, \" → quote), then find first [ to last ] and JSON.parse

tables.adspower_profiles: 19 AdsPower browser profiles — user_id, email, proxy, cookie_status, applicant data
tables.applied_jobs: Dedup log — job_id (PK), status, company, title, account_id
tables.executions: Full pipeline execution tracking — 1 row per apply_to_job call
tables.search_combinations: 10 keyword × state combos for daily N8N scrape
tables.proxies: 100 Webshare US residential SOCKS5 proxies — assigned_to = user_id
tables.gmail_accounts: 23 Gmail accounts — email, password, adspower_user_id, status
